title: Equal shape does not mean equal values
purpose: Reshape groups the physical sequence; transpose swaps the axes. Both can have shape three by two.
contract: R[0,1] = 2; Aᵀ[0,1] = 4; both alias the original owner
reshape_view requires canonical strides and equal checked element count
